marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Super skills require supreme confidence, imagination and courage. Part I highlights super skills such as chip passes, banana shots, side volleys, overhead scissor volleys and more. Each skill is carefully reviewed and demonstrated with slow motion replays and world game action footage. Part 2 features heading-- considered by many to be the most unique skill in sports. This section deals with the proper contact and body movement for offensive and defensive heading, dive heading, heading for goal and much more.
